text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /tmp/exposed-delta-architecture/revised-judgment.md <<'EOF'
Recommend C as the base, with explicit reconciliation and replay details from B. Scores assess the submitted text before corrections.

| Candidate | Scope isolation | Acquisition correctness | Existing domain behavior | Crash publication | Maintainability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | 5 | 3 | 2 | 5 | 4 |
| B | 5 | 3 | 2 | 5 | 4 |
| C | 5 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 5 |

All three keep member maintenance separate and correctly distinguish filtered discovery from unfiltered hydration. They retain global interpretation, which preserves existing descendants and corpus-wide identity context. Their publication designs couple the projection and checkpoint transactionally.

A explicitly rejects missing or cross-member parents. B requires parent evidence before sealing, with the same likely consequence. Existing parent attribution deliberately represents these cases as unavailable. Completeness must mean successful acquisition under the declared policy, not universal parent existence. C avoids that explicit semantic change but leaves parent acquisition underspecified.

Use C's acquisition boundary and ownership structure. Add B's explicit declaration reconciliation for bootstrap and cohort expansion, retained former members, and committed-run replay check before the expected-revision check. Bind checkpoint coverage to an immutable cohort fingerprint. Declare the cohort separately from record owners so members with zero declarations remain eligible. Require a sealed baseline.

For newly referenced missing same-member parents, attempt unfiltered hydration. Distinguish a genuine source absence from transport, pagination, or decoding failure. Genuine absent or cross-member parent attribution stays unavailable under existing semantics. Unexpected ownership changes in a hydrated declaration remain acquisition errors.

Correct all candidates' evidence language. Immutable historical responses are audit evidence. A successful complete hydration replaces that declaration's authoritative source payload, including corrected JSON within the same register and its complete current funding-entry set. Never union stale fields or funding entries back into that payload. Retain unchanged declarations. Whole-record source disappearance needs a separate explicit outcome and policy; it does not make removed funding entries ambiguous.

Verify parent-only corrections, unavailable parents, same-register corrections removing funding, cohort changes, restart after commit, and competing publishers against full interpretation of equivalent authoritative evidence.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));

content.text:
Wrote [revised-judgment.md](/tmp/exposed-delta-architecture/revised-judgment.md).

Recommend C, with B's explicit reconciliation and replay ordering. Required corrections preserve unavailable-parent behavior, distinguish acquisition failures from genuine absence, and replace each hydrated declaration's current payload without restoring stale funding entries.
